Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You catch the loose end, offer the missing word, or put your shoulder beside a friend’s.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One adjacent ally
Duration
Until the start of your next turn, or until the aided roll is made.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Universal

Plausibly assist a declared task. Proposal: the ally gains 1 Boon to that task’s next roll before the start of your next turn. Outside combat, contribute Aid or your own group roll, not both.
